# Requirements Quality Checklist: Linux CLI Knowledge Assistant

**Purpose**: Self-review checklist ensuring the feature requirements are complete, clear, and aligned ahead of implementation
**Created**: 2025-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are prerequisites and bootstrap steps for offline-first installation fully enumerated, including Podman/Ollama setup, disk space, and optional archive downloads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Quickstart §Prerequisites]
- [ ] CHK002 Do the requirements enumerate all ingestion and refresh triggers (manual, scheduled, CLI commands) that must be supported? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Phase 2 – Ingestion Workflows]
- [ ] CHK003 Are feedback capture and review requirements covering storage, retrieval, and admin surfaces documented end-to-end? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §User Story 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the expected output for `ragman-admin status` (counts, timestamps, schedule metadata) specified with concrete fields? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 Are success messages and progress feedback for ingestion defined with measurable descriptors (e.g., percent complete, source identifiers)? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the selection process for optional Kiwix archives (catalog filtering, naming) explicitly described? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Clarifications §2025-10-15]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do scheduler and refresh requirements align across spec, plan, and tasks without conflicting cadence definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Phase 2 – Ingestion Workflows, Tasks §T013–T016]
- [ ] CHK008 Are CLI flag behaviors consistent across spec narratives and task breakdowns for both binaries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Technical Context, Tasks §T021–T028, §T035–T043]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Are offline installation success criteria measurable, including completion time and source coverage thresholds? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Do refresh/status acceptance scenarios specify objective pass/fail signals (timestamps updated, skipped documents reported)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-009]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are recovery flows for failed ingestion or refresh (retry strategy, remediation guidance) explicitly required? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for initial empty or partially ingested knowledge bases to ensure usable responses? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Is expected behavior documented when Kiwix catalog downloads fail or archives remain unavailable offline? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Clarifications §2025-10-15]
- [ ] CHK014 Are cache eviction notifications and user guidance for purged answers specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-004]

## Non-Functional Requirements

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Are assumptions about existing man pages and local admin privileges validated or flagged for confirmation? [Dependencies, Spec §Assumptions & Dependencies]
